info.title: CaliBuddy API
info.description: Calisthenics training log. Sign in through Better Auth (`/api/auth/*`): every route below needs its session cookie.

delete.description: Programme days using the template become rest days; logged sessions keep their copy.

200.description: The session in progress, or null
Current step of every started progression

post.description: Saves the results and places every progression at its starting step.

200.description: Everything the user has logged, as a JSON file

put.description: Replaces all of the user’s data with a backup, all or nothing. Accepts the exports of the former local-only app.
